scope: Diagnostic normal-camera pickup samples, controlled world/seed in isolated memory gym. Static full-body route to selected searchable node (first safe by default; QA_NODE_ID explicit when set). Ordinary keyboard input; no health, time, loot, visibility or position writes. Not a natural first-time discovery or full expedition.
